title: Reuse two identical completed scalar products within one source-centered offset group at one key

basis.observed_refusal: P11 key 36 at 36/25, right-eye offset diagonal times original local z
basis.source_relation: Original reach-assets sibling eyes attach identically to the same head; vectors are (-0.1,0.05,0.23) and (+0.1,0.05,0.23) as exact decoded binary64 rationals.

selection.source: ontokin/reach_reference_center.py:_offset and bounded source-only group preparation
selection.scope: One admitted source group, orientation and key; generic eligibility derived from sealed source identities/axes/vectors, never fixture names.

algebra.rounding: Retain each original floor at the original final combined expression; do not move a floor across addition, subtraction or negation.

selection.ownership: Reuse only already completed exact values in the same bounded group/key; do not publish pending source cursors or poses early.

required_derivation: Prove each selected original multiplication has identical native exact operands and original prospective/result bounds; retain final rounding and exact output bits.
Derive a sealed source-only relation without looking at observed output tracks, declared certificate claims or fixture names.
Prove no cross-clock, cross-phase, cross-owner or changed-domain reuse; maintain independent source authority.
Account for finite temporary storage, lifetime, ownership and all admissions under the existing numerical-cache and metadata limits; nonpersistent storage is not automatically exempt.
Preserve each node's position addition, radius decision and final pending source admission.
Preserve native dispatch gates and the original custom-dispatch fallback, original exceptions, cancellation identity, mutation detection and nested-writer behavior at remaining boundaries.
Measure and reconcile all admission, lookup, guard, receipt and arithmetic charges; prove a positive net saving for the bounded eligible group before implementation proceeds.
required_future_controls: Positive eligible pair with exact raw results, complete GLB bytes and entire reports where a request completes.
Ineligible unequal operands, nonmirrored or unrelated relations, changed axes/orientations/clocks/phases/owners, nonnative exact values, changed precision/operand limits and cache pressure.
Mutation through callback-held aliases before and during preparation, between shared-product completion and use, before final floor/publication; restored dispatch must not erase a detected departure.

Custom arithmetic, external checks, native observer restoration, cancellation and resource refusal at every newly affected boundary; failure must preserve accepted state and original exception identity.
Nested writers and failed pending batches; no stale receipt or provisional pose may escape.
Actual charged-operation reconciliation including zero/negative-savings cases; hold them as failures rather than relabeling.
Fresh original P11 and L03 requests under unchanged horizons/settings/caps; L03's existing 64-step reseed is a mandatory unchanged control.
Any accepted runtime change requires fresh original28, affected regression and full required local/compatibility/release evidence on its actual source cut.
hold_conditions: No positive net charged saving after all overhead
Changed fixtures, thresholds, limits or expected outcomes would be needed
excluded: Changing the 64-step cursor cap or direct seeding
Changing radii, tolerances, source fixtures, oracles, horizons, fps or helpers
Assuming P11 or L03 will pass from a local saving
P16 retained-clock and P23 producer work; both remain separate scopes

unselected_extension.description: A mirrored-pair algebra can express both offsets using four absolute-sign products instead of eight original multiplications.
unselected_extension.reason: Signed operand normalization changes add/sub calls and requires a separate exact/native-dispatch/callback/exception derivation. This is conditional source algebra, not a captured kernel saving.
